title.zh: v2.0.46 播放走带状态绝对同步、步进矩阵视界自动跟随指针开关、桌面端虚拟键盘居中人机工学重塑、多小节完整和弦走向展开与钢琴卷帘首音自适应聚焦
title.en: v2.0.46 Playback State Synchronization, Auto-Follow Playhead Setting, Desktop Ergonomic Centered Virtual Keyboard, Multi-Bar Chord Progression Expansion & Piano Roll Initial Note Centering

highlights.zh: **播放按钮走带状态绝对同步（Playback Button State Coherence & Engine Event Bridge）**：排查并修复了在连续切换曲风或停止重播时播放按钮显示“播放”而音频已在发声的状态不同步缺陷。在 `AudioEngine` 底层注入 `onPlay` 回调监听机制并在 `useAudioEngineLifecycle` 中双向同步 `setIsPlaying(true)`；在 `useGenreSwitching` 切曲风恢复播放时显式校准播放态，彻底杜绝状态漂移。
highlights.en: **Playback Button State Coherence & Engine Event Bridge**: Fixed transport desync where the play button displayed "Play" while audio was actively sounding after switching genres. Integrated an `onPlay` callback directly into `AudioEngine`, wired bidirectional state syncing in `useAudioEngineLifecycle`, and explicitly synchronized playback state in `useGenreSwitching`.

highlights.zh: **步进矩阵播放视界自动跟随指针系统设置（Auto-Follow Playhead Step Matrix Viewport Setting）**：在系统全局设置「界面设置」中新增「播放时步进板块跟随播放指针（Auto-follow playhead in sequencer grid）」持久化开关（默认开启）。在播放走带过程中，当扫描光束运行至可视区域右侧或首步循环折返时，自动平滑横向滚动音序器步进矩阵，确保当前发音步进始终位于视界中心。
highlights.en: **Auto-Follow Playhead Step Matrix Viewport Setting**: Added a persistent toggle in Global Settings -> Interface Preferences for "Auto-follow playhead in sequencer grid" (enabled by default). During playback, as the scanning playhead approaches the right edge or wraps back to Step 1, the step matrix automatically scrolls horizontally to keep the active playhead continuously in view.

highlights.zh: **桌面端虚拟键盘居中人机工学重塑（Desktop Virtual Keyboard Centering & Proportional Ergonomics）**：重塑桌面端虚拟键盘视觉排版，解除宽屏下 100% 满屏无界拉伸，将桌面端宽度优雅限制为最大 820px（`w-full sm:max-w-[760px] md:max-w-[820px] mx-auto`）并在屏幕底端平整居中；琴键垂直高度调整为 `h-24 sm:h-28 md:h-28`，消除按键过于宽大粗重的失真比例，呈现真实便携式键盘的细腻触感与专业美感。
highlights.en: **Desktop Virtual Keyboard Centering & Proportional Ergonomics**: Refined desktop musical typing layout by removing excessive 100% full-width stretching across wide monitors. Constrained keybed width to a tasteful centered container (`max-w-[820px] mx-auto`) and adjusted key heights (`h-24 sm:h-28 md:h-28`) for realistic, authentic piano proportions.
